title: Master Kitchen Inventory
summary: Adds one long, categorized inventory catalog for the initial kitchen count and ongoing Have and Buy quantities.
behavior: Adds Master Kitchen Inventory to the Your Kitchen navigation.
Builds an accordion catalog from curated product forms plus every named ingredient currently present in the recipe library.
Keeps fresh, frozen, canned, packaged, and prepared forms as separate inventory records.
Provides iPad-friendly Have, Buy, and notes fields with automatic local saving.
Moves recorded purchases into Have quantities and clears the related Buy quantities.
Supports custom product forms, search, expand and collapse controls, and a printable initial-count worksheet.
Includes the master inventory in full-site Backup & Restore for transfer between devices.
Prevents ambiguous recipe alternatives from being presented as safe automatic deductions.
